# Frontend libraries

Pinned local copies for operation without CDN access. Preserve upstream notices embedded in each file.

- Tailwind CSS browser runtime 3.4.17 (MIT): https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17
- Chart.js 4.4.8 (MIT): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.8/dist/chart.umd.js
- Marked 15.0.7 (MIT): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@15.0.7/marked.min.js
- Font Awesome Free 6.4.0: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css
- Font Awesome webfonts: same release under /webfonts/. License: https://fontawesome.com/license/free (icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT).

These pinned versions are for reproducibility, not a claim of being the newest or vulnerability-free. Review dependency advisories and licenses during upgrades.
